official.deadline_note: The 30 October 2026 date (23:59 Chile time) is the deadline for each national PUNTO FOCAL to upload preselected candidacies into AGCID's Plataforma de Gestion de Becas; the convocatoria tells applicants that the application deadline at each Punto Focal must be verified by the interested party, so the national office sets an earlier date that actually governs the applicant.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria Ano 2027 (academic year 2027; studies starting between 1 March and 30 September 2027)
official.status_note: AGCID's official 'Ofertas Vigentes' feed for foreign scholars (as read on 2026-10-11) lists the programme with 'Plazo Final de Postulacion: 30-10-2026' and states that final selection results will be communicated from the second fortnight of November 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Pago del costo de arancel, matricula y costos de titulacion que cobre la respectiva institucion de educacion superior, por el tiempo que dure el programa de postgrado, con un tope de cuatro semestres academicos, o seis trimestres academicos, dependiendo de la calendarizacion utilizada por la respectiva institucion.
benefits: Pago del costo de arancel, matricula y costos de titulacion que cobre la respectiva institucion de educacion superior, con un tope de cuatro semestres academicos o seis trimestres academicos

Pago, a partir del mes en que el/la becario/a inicie el periodo de estudio, de una asignacion mensual de manutencion de seiscientos mil pesos chilenos ($ 600.000), con un tope de hasta veinticuatro (24) meses

Provision al/a becario/a, mientras la beca se encuentre vigente, de un seguro de vida, salud y accidentes, por los hechos o siniestros que le afecten y que acaezcan dentro del territorio de Chile; adicionalmente acceso a atencion a traves del Sistema y Servicios de Salud Publica chilenos una vez que cuente con la cedula nacional de identidad
Otorgamiento, dentro de su primer periodo lectivo en el programa de estudio, de una asignacion unica para textos y materiales de estudio, ascendente a la suma de noventa mil pesos chilenos ($ 90.000)

Asignacion por un monto equivalente a trescientos mil pesos ($300.000), para apoyo a gastos de la tesis o del requisito analogo exigido por la institucion, pagada por una sola vez y siempre que el promedio de calificaciones sea igual o superior a 5,5 o su escala equivalente
Los beneficios de los numerales II, III y IV no aplicaran a becarios seleccionados que cursen programas en forma virtual
eligibility: Ser nacional de Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Panama, Republica Dominicana o de los paises miembros del CARICOM (Antigua y Barbuda, Bahamas, Barbados, Belice, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, Montserrat, Santa Lucia, St. Kitts y Nevis, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Surinam y Trinidad y Tobago)

Contar con aceptacion incondicional de un programa de Magister en una universidad u otra institucion chilena de educacion superior; la postulacion a un programa que no este registrado en el Anexo 1 no sera considerado en el proceso de seleccion
No se aceptaran candidaturas de extranjeros que posean visa de residencia y/o trabajo en Chile

No se aceptara postulantes cuyo conyuge sea beneficiario/a de esta beca u otra de AGCID; si postulantes a una misma convocatoria son conyuges, solo uno/a de ellos/as podra obtener una beca si es seleccionado/a
Criterio de prioridad: candidaturas presentadas por funcionarias/os publicas/os o academicas/os de universidades reconocidas por el pais de la/el postulante
requirements: Presentar los antecedentes en formato electronico, debidamente escaneados y legibles, al PUNTO FOCAL del pais del postulante y una copia electronica a la Embajada de Chile en el pais que presenta al postulante

Realizar directamente los tramites necesarios para la admision al programa de magister y contar con la aceptacion incondicional de la institucion; la aceptacion al programa y los eventuales costos de este procedimiento es de responsabilidad de cada postulante
Estar en posesion de los grados o titulos academicos apostillados y/o legalizados y de los requisitos curriculares exigidos por la institucion de educacion superior en la que ha sido aceptado/a

Dedicarse exclusivamente a los estudios durante la vigencia de la beca, incluyendo la prohibicion de desempenar labores remuneradas en Chile, y aprobar la totalidad de las asignaturas con un promedio de calificaciones igual o superior a 5,0 o su escala equivalente
documents: Formulario de postulacion a Beca AGCID (ANEXO 4), debidamente completado en computador y firmado

Carta de aceptacion definitiva emitida por la autoridad competente de la institucion chilena, que acredite la aceptacion incondicional, la modalidad (presencial, hibrida, online), la fecha de inicio y termino del programa incluida la tesis y el examen de grado, y el valor de la matricula y el arancel anual
Certificado de salud compatible emitido y suscrito por un medico habilitado, con indicacion de las enfermedades preexistentes declaradas por el/la postulante (ANEXO 5)

Certificado original de Titulo Profesional o copia autorizada por un notario publico; en caso de ser seleccionado debera ser apostillado o legalizado por las autoridades respectivas en el pais que entrega el certificado

Curriculum Vitae con enfasis en antecedentes laborales y academicos; carta de motivacion que contenga las razones que lo impulsan a realizar estudios en Chile, los objetivos y como se propone aplicarlos al regresar a su pais; carta de referencia academica; carta de patrocinio de la institucion empleadora (si aplica); breve descripcion de la posible area y tema de tesis

Documento Excel/Word con informacion relacionada con el programa de Magister y del Becario (informacion obligatoria), copia de pasaporte, y documento oficial emitido por la Embajada de su pais que certifique el dominio del idioma espanol, si correspondiera de acuerdo al pais
selection_criteria: Prioridad asignada por el pais a la postulacion, ponderacion 0.20: primera prioridad 100 puntos, segunda 80, tercera 65, cuarta 40, quinta 20, otra prioridad 5

Experiencia laboral profesional en el ambito del programa de estudios, ponderacion 0.25: 5 anos o mas 100 puntos, 3 anos y menos de 5 65 puntos, entre 6 meses y 3 anos 35 puntos, menor a 6 meses o sin experiencia 5 puntos
Postulaciones relacionadas con las prioridades alineadas a la politica exterior de Chile, ponderacion 0.15: SI 100 puntos, NO 0 puntos
Institucion en que se desempena al momento de la postulacion, ponderacion 0.10: Institucion Publica 100 puntos, Institucion Privada 50 puntos
Genero, ponderacion 0.10: postulaciones de Mujeres 100 puntos, postulaciones de Hombres 50 puntos; Edad, ponderacion 0.05: entre 36 y 50 anos 100 puntos, menos de 36 50 puntos, mas de 50 20 puntos
Criterio Regional, ponderacion 0.05: postulaciones a Universidad en Regiones 100 puntos, postulaciones a Universidad en Region Metropolitana (Santiago) 50 puntos
coverage: Costo de arancel, matricula y costos de titulacion de la institucion chilena de educacion superior, con tope de cuatro semestres academicos o seis trimestres academicos, y solo para costos que correspondan exclusivamente al curriculum academico del programa

Asignacion mensual de manutencion de $600.000 pesos chilenos, desde el mes de inicio de estudios y con tope de 24 meses; en diciembre, enero y/o febrero la autorizacion de salida del pais es requisito para recibir el 100% de la asignacion de dicho periodo
Seguro de vida, salud y accidentes por hechos ocurridos dentro del territorio de Chile y atencion en el sistema de salud publica chileno
Asignacion unica de $90.000 para textos y materiales de estudio en el primer periodo lectivo
Asignacion unica de $300.000 para gastos de tesis o del requisito analogo para el grado academico

AGCID no pagara gasto alguno que no se encuentre contemplado: tramites de visa, costos de postulacion a las instituciones de educacion superior chilenas, tasas de embarque aereo u otros impuestos analogos y costos por viajes o traslados a su pais durante el desarrollo de la beca, entre otros
application_method: Enviar la documentacion en formato electronico a la institucion gubernamental local denominada PUNTO FOCAL del pais del postulante (listado en Anexo 3) y una copia electronica a la Embajada de Chile en ese pais
El Punto Focal verifica el cumplimiento de los requisitos de postulacion e incorpora las candidaturas oficialmente presentadas a la Plataforma de Gestion de Becas AGCID
Preseleccion realizada en el pais por un Comite Mixto de Preseleccion integrado por el Punto Focal y el funcionario designado por la Embajada de Chile, quienes podran entrevistar a los postulantes

Seleccion definitiva por el Comite de Seleccion del Programa en Chile; la decision no es susceptible de recurso alguno y la beca se materializa mediante la firma del documento de aceptacion de la beca (Anexo 2)
official.application_route: Not a direct application to AGCID: assemble the electronic file and send it to the national PUNTO FOCAL (Anexo 3) with a copy to the Chilean embassy, holding unconditional admission to an Anexo 1 master's programme; the focal point uploads the preselected candidacy into AGCID's Plataforma de Gestion de Becas.
official.study_mode: Full-time with exclusive dedication (dedicacion exclusiva); priority given to scholarships with residence in Chile for the whole study period (presencial or hibrida); programmes run virtually do not receive the monthly allowance, insurance or study-materials benefits.
official.citizenship_residency: Only nationals of the invited Latin American and Caribbean countries and CARICOM member states; applications from foreigners holding a residence and/or work visa in Chile are not accepted.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - for degree-holding professionals who are nationals of the invited Latin American and Caribbean countries; not open to Chilean nationals or to residents of Chile.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only the master's programmes listed in Anexo 1 of the convocatoria; priority thematic areas are Astronomia, Mineria, Ciencias Antarticas, Energias Renovables, Recursos Marinos, Desarrollo Economico, Comercio Internacional, Relaciones Internacionales, Soberania Integridad Territorio y Seguridad Nacional, and Lucha contra el Crimen Organizado y Terrorismo.
official.research_requirement: A brief description of the possible thesis area and topic must be included in the application, and the scholarship award for thesis costs requires the candidate to submit a thesis work schedule signed by the supervising professor, the approved thesis project (certificate) and an academic transcript with an average of at least 5.5 before the nineteenth month of the allowance.
official.duration: Up to a maximum of 24 months, according to the duration of the chosen study programme (up to four academic semesters or six trimesters of tuition coverage).
official.description: AGCID states that the purpose of the programme is to contribute to the formation of advanced human capital through the participation of Latin American and Caribbean professionals in master's programmes taught by Chilean universities and higher-education institutions accredited to a high level of excellence. The South-South cooperation scholarship programme began in 1993 and more than 1,602 Latin American and Caribbean professionals have won the scholarship to date.
official.region: Latin America and the Caribbean (invited countries, including CARICOM member states)
official.program_type: Government scholarship - South-South cooperation (long-duration master's degree)

not_confirmed: english_requirement - the convocatoria and AGCID's platform publish no English test or MOI requirement for this call (instruction is in Spanish and some countries must supply an embassy certificate of Spanish proficiency)
national focal-point deadlines - each Punto Focal sets its own earlier date for receiving files and no official AGCID page consulted publishes those national dates
verification.notes: Read AGCID's own 'Convocatoria Republica de Chile 2027' PDF (section C lists the CLP 600,000 monthly maintenance allowance, tuition/matriculation/titulacion payment, insurance and the CLP 90,000 and CLP 300,000 one-off payments) and AGCID's live 'Ofertas Vigentes' feed on its official scholarship platform appspublic.agci.cl, which is the iframe embedded in the agcid.gob.cl ofertas vigentes page; the 30 October 2026 deadline and required-document list come from that platform, and Annex 3 confirms the focal points of the invited countries.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a government-funded master's scholarship that pays the Chilean university's tuition, matriculation and degree costs plus a CLP 600,000 monthly living allowance for up to 24 months, but you cannot apply until you already hold unconditional admission to a master's programme listed in Annex 1. Applications do not go to AGCID directly: your country's focal point screens and uploads your file to AGCID's scholarship platform by 30 October 2026, 23:59 Chile time, so the national cut-off set by that office is the one you must hit. Airfare, visa costs, the university's own application and acceptance-letter charges, and any trip home during the award are on you, and once you are in Chile you must study full-time, cannot take paid work, and are expected to return home afterwards.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A mid-career public official, university academic or civil-society professional from an invited Latin American or Caribbean country who already holds unconditional admission to an accredited Chilean master's in one of AGCID's priority fields such as mining, renewable energy, astronomy, marine resources, international trade or international relations.
application_readiness_checklist: Email your country's Punto Focal from Annex 3 (not AGCID) before anything else and ask in writing for its internal receipt deadline, which is earlier than 30 October 2026

Confirm the exact master's programme appears in the updated Annex 1 list before paying any university admission fees, then secure an unconditional acceptance letter that states the modality, start and end dates including thesis and degree exam, the matriculation value and the annual arancel
Complete AGCID's application form (Anexo 4) signed, and fill in the mandatory Excel data sheet about the programme and yourself, since incomplete files are grounds for elimination
Book a licensed physician to complete the health declaration (Anexo 5) including pre-existing conditions, because it underpins the insurance AGCID contracts

Have the professional degree certificate notarised (and later apostilled or legalised in your own country), plus a valid passport, and obtain an embassy document certifying Spanish proficiency if your country requires one
Ask your employer for a sponsorship letter confirming release for the full study period, and budget separately for airfare, visa and residence procedures and the first month in Chile
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a master's programme that is missing from Annex 1, which the convocatoria states will not be considered in the selection process
A conditional, pending or verbal admission, or an acceptance letter that omits the tuition figures, modality or the study period including the thesis and degree exam
An incomplete file or falsified documentation, which the convocatoria makes explicit grounds for elimination
Missing your national focal point's internal deadline even though the central deadline is 30 October 2026, or holding a Chilean residence or work visa
Being a spouse of another AGCID beneficiary or of another applicant in the same call, since only one of the pair can be awarded
Choosing a fully online programme, which forfeits the monthly allowance, the insurance and the study-materials payment, and selecting a programme outside the priority thematic areas
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Airfare and airport taxes, visa and residence procedures, the university's own application fees and the cost of the acceptance letter, travel or trips home during the award, and any expense outside the enumerated benefits are explicitly the student's responsibility; the CLP 600,000 monthly allowance must also cover day-to-day living costs in Chile.
document_audit: The acceptance letter must be issued by the competent authority of the Chilean institution and must state unconditional acceptance, modalidad, start and end dates including the thesis and degree exam, and the matriculation and annual arancel values
The Excel/Word document with programme and candidate information is marked as mandatory in the official document list
The degree certificate must be an original or a notarised copy and, if selected, must be apostilled or legalised in the issuing country, so start that procedure early
The health certificate must be signed and stamped by a licensed physician and disclose pre-existing illness; this drives AGCID's insurance cover
A passport copy and, for some countries, an embassy-issued document certifying command of Spanish are part of the required set
alerts: The 30 October 2026 date is the deadline for focal points to upload, not for candidates: verify your national deadline early

The student visa can take up to two months, so begin the online procedure at tramites.extranjeria.gob.cl as soon as you have the definitive acceptance letter or the selection notice, since you cannot enter Chile without it

While the scholarship runs you may not leave Chile without AGCID authorisation, and in December, January and February you receive 100% of the allowance only for authorised periods tied to the academic break
The award forbids paid work in Chile, requires passing every course with an average of at least 5.0, and requires returning to your home country at the end
A former AGCID postgraduate scholar cannot reapply for another AGCID postgraduate scholarship until five years after the original award ended (three years for short specialisation courses)
Selection scores reward the priority your country assigns you, so ask your focal point how it ranks presented candidates
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: The candidate emails the complete electronic file to the national Punto Focal with a copy to the Chilean embassy; the focal point and the embassy pre-select and rank the file, and the focal point then uploads it into AGCID's Plataforma de Gestion de Becas before the 30 October 2026 cut-off.
